A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the QCD sum rule analysis of the lightest scalar resonance in the I=0, JPC=0++ channel, when performed within a Laplace sum rule formalism that includes both the direct instanton contribution as well as the three-loop-order pertubative contribution, leads to the conclusion that the mass and the width are strongly correlated.

a sigma with mass of order 400–600 MeV is not compatible with the QCD Laplace-sum-rule approach, whereas a sigma with mass in the 600–700-MeV range can be accommodated by QCD Laplace sums, but only if its total width is less than 200–300 MeV.
